title: The Tainted Dinner Party
story: On a cold evening, the elite and wealthy gathered at the opulent mansion of Mrs. Blackwood for a dinner party to discuss the latest philanthropic endeavor. Among the guests were: Mr. Whitewood, a successful businessman; Ms. Ashwood, a renowned archaeologist; Dr. Greystone, a prominent surgeon; and Sir Stonybridge, a renowned explorer.
crimeScene: The lavish mansion was decorated with exotic flora, and the dining table displayed an exquisite feast prepared by the finest chef in town.
forensicClue: A small vial found near the scene contains an unknown poison.
question: Who is the mastermind behind the plot and how did they infiltrate the dinner party?
options: Option A (Mrs. Blackwood and the motive)
Option B (Mr. Whitewood and the alibi)
Option C (Ms. Ashwood and the hidden motive)
Option D (Dr. Greystone and the inconsistency)
